articles.title: Uber and Lyft launch shuttles to Logan Airport in Boston

articles.summary: CBS News Videos: Uber and Lyft launch shuttles to Logan Airport in Boston. Uber announced today that it is offering a new shuttle service to Boston's Logan Airport.

articles.title: Lyft To Announce First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
articles.mainIdea: Lyft To Announce First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
articles.summary: Business Wire: Lyft To Announce First Quarter 2026 Financial Results. SAN FRANCISCO, April 16, 2026--Lyft, Inc. (Nasdaq: LYFT) (the "Company" or "Lyft") will release financial results for the first quarter of 2026 after the close of the market on Thursday, May 7, 2026.

articles.title: Nexar Launches BADAS 2.0: The World's Best Incident Prediction Model, Trained on Two Million Real-World Events
articles.mainIdea: Nexar Launches BADAS 2.0: The World's Best Incident Prediction Model, Trained on Two Million Real-World Events
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Nexar Launches BADAS 2.0: The World's Best Incident Prediction Model, Trained on Two Million Real-World Events. Nexar, the real-world intelligence platform for the Physical AI era, today released BADAS 2.0, the next generation of its incident prediction model and the company's first model family. Built on the same V-JEPA2 architecture as BADAS 1.0, the new generation was trained on five times the real-world data, producing a model family that outperforms its predecessor on every benchmark and outperforms a 2-billion-parameter foundation model at a fraction of the size.
